$comment: Private-target allowlist for scripts/link-check (issue #149). External URLs are never fetched by the gate (walled/anti-bot surfaces answer 403 to bots, #132), so a private family repo needs an explicit declaration, not a resolution. Each entry records WHY the target is private and the TRIGGER that removes it. A declared target nothing in scope references is reported as W-ALLOWLIST-UNUSED — the registry cannot rot silently. This file is data, not a manifest: Dependabot does not read it.

privateTargets.reason: Private satellite of the family (STANDARDS community item 10, community-first §9): the workspace template the quickstart clones. Links to it resolve only for insiders while it stays private.
privateTargets.removalTrigger: Remove this entry when `profile-data-template` flips to public (the visibility flip of STANDARDS "To go public") — the URL then resolves for everyone and the declaration is dead weight.
